StyleAudioMeter.doc: The microphone level over the camera preview (`OnboardingAudioMeter`): the pill around it, and the meter's track and fill.

StyleAvatar.doc: Circular avatars: a photo filling the circle, else initials, else an icon.

StyleBrandLogo.doc: 360 Care Group brand symbol and full horizontal logo lockup presets.

StyleCard.doc: Content containers. Tones (`success`, `warning`, `error`, `info`) double as callout banners; `interactive` lifts and glows on hover.

StyleCardSection.doc: Accordion and media cards share the card chrome with no padding, so headers and bodies can draw their own.

StyleChecklistStepRow.doc: One step of the candidate checklist dashboard (`OnboardingChecklistStepRow`): a full-bleed row of a flush category card (`StyleCard.flush`), divided from the next by an `OnboardingDivider`. `actionable` rows (every row that answers a tap, a gated one included) tint on hover and press; `inert` rows (completed by the recruiter) stay still. Phones tighten the side padding to the mobile page gutter.

StyleCommentBubble.doc: A chat bubble in an `OnboardingFieldFeedback` comment thread: `incoming` (default) sits on a neutral subtle surface, while `outgoing` tints the bubble in the primary brand colour.

StyleContentList.doc: Scrollable list of page sections (used with `StyledListView`).

StyleCountdown.doc: The time left on an answer, a pill over the camera preview (`OnboardingCountdown`).

StyleDocumentPreview.doc: A stored document: its image `thumbnail` in a review row, and the full-size `frame` in the preview modal.

StyleDragHandle.doc: The grip an item is dragged by (`OnboardingDragHandle`): `overlay` is a small surface chip that sits on an image, such as a course card's cover; `plain` is the bare grip of a reorderable table row.

StyleDropLine.doc: The accent line where a dragged block would land.

StyleGapInsert.doc: The gap between blocks: invisible until hovered, then a line with a "+" handle.

StyleGutterGrip.doc: The drag grip in the gutter left of a block.

StyleIconBadge.doc: Square icon badges (checklist step icons, card headers, empty states).

StyleIconButton.doc: Square icon-only buttons. `OnboardingIconButton(icon, style: const StyleIconButton.outlined())`.

StyleIconToken.doc: Semantic icon colours. `StyledIcon(TablerIcons.check, style: const StyleIconToken.success())`.

StyleInspectorSection.doc: Section headers inside the Inspector (Content, Style, Layout).

StyleKpiCard.doc: KPI metric cards; `selectable` is used as a filter and reacts to `selected`.

StyleLessonCard.doc: Cards (feature, image, quote, flip): the `tone` variants.

StyleLessonCardText.doc: Text inside cards. These set no colour, so a dark card's inverse text applies.

StyleLessonContainer.doc: Container block: a tinted box around its children, `tone` and `inset` are block props.

StyleLessonHeading.doc: Headings: `level` 1–4 maps to the type scale; `tone` and `align` are block props.

StyleLessonMediaFrame.doc: Image and video frames: the `frame` block prop.

StyleLessonMediaPlaceholder.doc: Placeholder for media without a file yet, and for video until a player exists.

StyleLessonOption.doc: Quiz and scenario options: `selected` while chosen, variants after checking.

StyleLessonSheet.doc: The sheet the blocks sit on; the variant is the lesson's `LessonWidth`.

StyleMediaCover.doc: The parts of an `OnboardingMediaCard` with a cover: the [cover] image area (a tinted ground with the fallback icon when there is no image), the [overlay] row pinned over its top edge (a drag handle on the left, a status badge on the right) and the padded [body] below.

StyleModal.doc: Modal dialog frame in four sizes.

StylePageTitle.doc: Page title block: on a full-bleed surface with a bottom divider ([normal], [tabbed]), or straight on the page background ([plain]) for portal pages whose content sits in cards below it.

StyleProgressRing.doc: The box of an `OnboardingProgressRing`: `normal` beside other content, `hero` for the candidate dashboard's dual-arc ring (`OnboardingProgressRing.hero`).

StyleRadio.doc: Radio outer ring; `selected` fills the ring colour, the inner dot is the thumb.

StyleRecorderFrame.doc: The interview recorder's camera preview (`OnboardingRecorderFrame`): the media background, rounded and clipped, filling the width; its 16:9 box sets the height. Text and icons laid over it are `onMedia`.

StyleReviewGroupHeader.doc: Full-bleed page-group subheader band inside a flush review card (`PERSONAL DETAILS`, `4 of 12 approved`).

StyleReviewRow.doc: A field under review: a full-bleed row of a flush card, divided from the next by a hairline. `rejected` tints the row, `inactive` mutes a not-applicable field shown for reference, `hovered` tints with the subtle token of the row's status (`successSubtle` approved, `warningSubtle` to review or a warning, `errorSubtle` rejected) and with the primary brand subtle token (`primarySubtle`, distinct from `StyleReviewGroupHeader`) for an unfilled or not-applicable field, and a row being edited (`active`) marks the active state while keeping the row surface clean.

StyleReviewStatus.doc: Inline status icon + label at the trailing edge of an `OnboardingReviewRow` when not hovered.

StyleSectionRailItem.doc: Full-bleed checklist section row inside a flush rail card: status-coloured leading icon, status-tinted hover and press fills, and a status left accent bar plus subtle status fill when `selected` (`onSurfaceMuted` / neutral surface tokens for `awaiting`).

StyleSidebar.doc: Docked navigation sidebar (desktop) and overlay drawer (mobile).

StyleSignaturePad.doc: Signature canvas and stored-signature preview frame inside `OnboardingSignatureInput`.

StyleStatusCard.doc: A page's single status message (`OnboardingStatusCard`): [StyleCard]'s chrome with its content and every line of text centred. `success` is the approved celebration tone.

StyleStatusSegment.doc: One block of a status segment bar: a rounded bar coloured by checklist status.

StyleStatusSwatch.doc: The square colour key beside a status legend label, in the colours of [_StyleStatusSegmentSpec].

StyleSwatch.doc: Colour swatch button for the colour picker; the fill is a data colour.

StyleTagChip.doc: Tag chips carrying a data colour (`TagModel.color`); tint levels come from the scale.

StyleTagPill.doc: Compact uppercase pills for table cells and sidebars.

StyleText.doc: Text presets built on the shared type scale in [OnboardingTypography], so presets and app code never drift apart. `customColor` is a data colour (a tag or chart series colour), never a design decision.

StyleThumbnail.doc: Rounded-square image for `OnboardingThumbnail`: a course cover in a table row (`sm`), a list (`md`) or beside a page title (`lg`). With no image (or one that fails to load) the tinted ground shows the fallback icon.

StyleTileButton.doc: Tile buttons: a large icon over a short title, in a box nearly as tall as it is wide. `OnboardingTileButton(icon: TablerIcons.photo, label: 'Image')`, laid out in an `OnboardingGrid` with `minItemWidth: OnboardingTokens.minButtonWidth` (the lesson editor's Insert pane).

StyleUploadItem.doc: Uploaded file row and upload-progress container inside `OnboardingFileUploadInput`.

StyleVideoBadge.doc: Inset around the duration badge pinned over the corner of a `StyleDocumentPreview.videoThumbnail`.

StyleWorkspacePane.doc: Workspace shell panes (editor sidebars) and its toolbar.

CrudFilterChip.summary: A selectable filter chip for a CrudToolbar, such as "Enabled (3)".

CrudToolbar.summary: Search, filters and actions above a collection.

CrudView.summary: Shows a collection as a table or a grid, with loading and empty states.

DesignOutlet.summary: Where a frame draws the page it frames. Only in a frame screen's tree.

Expanded.summary: Fills the remaining space of its row or column. Must be a direct child of one.

Flexible.summary: Takes up to its share of its row or column. Must be a direct child of one.

ModalScaffold.summary: The frame of every modal: title, body, and submit and cancel buttons.

OnboardingBreadcrumbItem.summary: One step of a breadcrumb trail. Link its tap unless it is the current page.

OnboardingBreadcrumbs.summary: The trail above a page title.

OnboardingButton.summary: The button. Pick the look with a named constructor or a StyleButton preset.

OnboardingCalloutBanner.summary: A tinted banner with an icon, a title and a message. Pick the tone with a named constructor.

OnboardingCard.summary: A surface card. Becomes interactive when its tap is linked.

OnboardingCardMenu.summary: A card's title row with a badge and a menu of actions.

OnboardingColumn.summary: A vertical flex with token spacing.

OnboardingDataTable.summary: Config-driven table with selection, sorting and row tap. Has its own card chrome.

props.name: idPath
props.doc: Path inside a row to its id. Replaces idOf.

OnboardingEmptyState.summary: What an empty collection shows: an icon, a title, a line of help and an optional action.

OnboardingIconButton.summary: A square icon-only button with an optional tooltip.

rules.message: An icon button in the last column of a table opens its tooltip to the left (tooltipPosition: left).

OnboardingKpiCard.summary: A card with a label, a large value and an optional trend.

OnboardingMetric.summary: One count of a metric strip.

OnboardingMetricStrip.summary: A row of clickable counts used as filters.

OnboardingPageHeader.summary: The header of a detail or editor page, with a back button, a badge and actions.

OnboardingPageTitle.summary: The title block at the top of a page, with breadcrumbs, actions and tabs.

OnboardingPopupMenu.summary: A menu of actions that opens from its child, such as a "more" icon button in a table row.

OnboardingPopupMenuItem.summary: One entry of a popup or card menu.

OnboardingSidebar.summary: The navigation sidebar: a header, sections of buttons and a footer.

OnboardingSidebarHeader.summary: The brand row at the top of the sidebar.

OnboardingSidebarSection.summary: A titled group of sidebar buttons.

OnboardingSidebarShell.summary: A shell with a sidebar beside the content.

OnboardingStatusBadge.summary: A small coloured label for a status. Pick the tone with a named constructor.

OnboardingSwitchInput.summary: An on/off switch with a label and an optional subtitle.

OnboardingTextInput.summary: A text field with a label, hint, help text and error.

OnboardingTooltip.summary: Shows a message when the pointer rests on its child.

OnboardingWrap.summary: Lays its children out in runs, wrapping to the next line, with token spacing.

StyledBox.summary: A box drawn by a preset. Prefer a library component when one fits.

StyledIcon.summary: An icon from the icon catalogue, coloured and sized by its style or its parent.

StyledImage.summary: An image from the host app, resolved from a reference.

StyledListView.summary: A page's one vertical scroll. A page's root is a StyledListView with StyleContentList.normal.

StyledText.summary: A run of text. Pick its look with a text preset such as StyleText.body.

ViewModeSwitcher.summary: Switches a collection between card and table view.

rules.message: A page's root is a StyledListView with StyleContentList.normal (README 3.2).
A StyledListView inside a page must use StyleContentList.flush: the page root is the only scroll (README 3.2).
A modal's root is a ModalScaffold (README 4.1).
